newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesian rupiah down on news of campaign clash.
newsitem.headline: Indonesian rupiah down on news of campaign clash.

text.p: The Indonesian rupiah fell against the dollar in mid-afternoon on news of a clash between supporters of the ruling Golkar party and a group of construction workers in Jakarta, dealers said.
They said the rupiah fell through the 2,440.0 resistance level to 2,442.0/43.0 at 0900 GMT from 2,433.0/34.0 at the opening. The rupiah earlier had found support at the 2,338 and 2,339 levels.
But dealers said the clash had given the rupiah another knock after it was driven down earlier by attacks on the Thai baht and also on nervousness over the election campaign.
Several people were injured in the clash, witnesses said.
They said Golkar supporters passing a construction site demanded that workers there join them in shouting political slogans. Stones were thrown after they refused.
They said several people suffered head wounds but the fighting died down before police reached the site.
Sporadic violence has marred the country's campaign for general elections scheduled for May 29.
Some dealers said short-term volatility in the run-up to the election had been factored in and was not a surprise.
The central bank raised its intervention band by one point to 2,408/2,600 and the conversion band by four points to 2,414/2,462 on Thursday.
